title: Slobolt lettuce: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Slobolt lettuce: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Slobolt lettuce is a leaf lettuce variety from Harris Seed. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Slobolt lettuce is a leaf lettuce variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1970. Harris Seed bred it. It takes 35 to 40 days from sowing to harvest.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Slobolt lettuce is grown

blocks.text: The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [lettuce variety finder](/crop-varieties/lettuce), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

items: **Days to harvest:** 35 to 40 days from sowing to harvest.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Slobolt lettuce takes 35 to 40 days from sowing to harvest. That is 21.2 days faster than the average of the 5 lettuce varieties with a day count, 58.7 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit lettuce fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Slobolt lettuce

Loose leaf lettuce grows in the lowlands, while heading types need the highlands. Pick a variety slow to bolt in the heat. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 35 to 40 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Slobolt?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
